name: vibebus
description: Project-scoped coordination for independent coding-agent tasks (Codex adapter).

interface.longDescription: Use a local SQLite fact bus with Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain for recoverable agents, responsibility-domain policy, bounded Git/test lifecycle facts, directed message lifecycles, atomically claimed tasks, agent task/thread bindings, renewable file reservations, replay-safe event subscriptions, operator-approved bounded retention, and structured handoffs across independent coding-agent tasks. This is the Codex adapter; sibling packages under plugins/ provide Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and Antigravity adapters.
defaultPrompt: Register this task with VibeBus and check its inbox.
Use VibeBus to coordinate this work with the other project tasks.
